# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is a fair, radiant, blonde young woman with an ethereal appearance. She is seen wearing silk clothing.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Though known as a dream girl with a dreamy manner, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She is contemplative, creative, and a driven scholar.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)_

## Traits

- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- humorous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)</sub>
- contemplative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- creative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- writing essays and presentations  <sub>[v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- to achieve fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

While studying at Regent's Academy, Honora became part of a small circle of driven and creative scholars around Nell Harcourt. She was initially assigned to teach at the Delford school, though she later took employment at her home school. As a supporter of the village improvement movement, she wrote an essay for the Improvement gathering and delivered a presentation regarding graveyards. During a spring day trip to the woods with Nell Harcourt and Odette Pullen, she shared her desire to achieve fame. She later brought her famous aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley, and Mrs. Pendexter to visit Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)_

## Background by volume

- attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>

## Quotes

> It would be my desire to achieve fame  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

> I muse upon the appearance of a soul . . . an individual's soul . . .  <sub>[v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)</sub>

> Also, my dear Nell, it grieves me deeply, yet I fear our trip to Grey Shutters is completely off, because once Aunty’s ankle has healed, returning to Toronto will be necessary for her. Her arrival there is required by a specific day.  <sub>[v2 c17 P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)</sub>

> I am sorry to drop in on you so suddenly, however, it was only yesterday evening that I learned about our trip. Aunt Charlotte leaves on Monday, and she had agreed to pass this day alongside a city friend. Yesterday evening, though, this friend called her on the phone to cancel the visit since scarlet fever had put them under quarantine. Consequently, I proposed that we travel to this place, as I was aware of how much you wished to visit her. After stopping by the Pale Sands Hotel, we picked up Mrs. Pendexter to join us. Being an acquaintance of aunt’s, she resides in New York, and a millionaire is her husband. Our visit must be brief, because Mrs. Pendexter needs to return to the hotel before five o’clock.  <sub>[v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>
